name: Illusio
_grid: One character per tile, row 0 = the far side (player 2), last row = player 1's side. Each character is defined in the legend. From the old map image (maps/illusio.jpg): four home islands (two per player) joined to the centre island by one-tile land strips, rope bridges over the sky between them, and the raised high ground in the middle.
_legend: level = height step (0 = lowest); tiles interact only within 1 level. surface picks the look from the palette. marker = something on the tile (painted on the board, and for flags/portals a 3D piece). paint: false = don't paint the marker. piece: true = also put a 3D piece there (flags, portals; pair = the portal pair it starts in). bridge: true = a rope bridge over the sky (no board there; a 3D bridge piece spans the run of bridge tiles between two islands).
_float: Floating islands: the whole board is lifted this many world units (at tile 3.24875) above the table, island edges drop a short cliff, and below that the rock tapers down to points (deepest under the middle of each island).
_board: The published board files the map picker uses (from tools/build_board.py; update when a new version is published), then run tools/build_arena_index.py.
_table: Image for the table around the board (placeholder until the arena gets its own).
_textures: Placeholders from tools/draw_placeholders.py (grass on the islands, pale stone on the high ground, rock on the cliffs and undersides).
